_doc: Information quarantine for catalog fields whose published value contradicts the product name. Applied to public/products.json by scripts/apply_spec_holds.py right after sync-sheets.mjs (sync-vps.sh step 1a). Held fields are blanked in every public representation (JSON/API, RU/EN cards, llms.txt, category pages) and replaced by a 'specification under review' note; the raw Sheet values stay in Google Sheets and in data/spec_holds_raw-<date>.json for the technologist. Remove an entry only after the technologist confirms the row against label photo + specification (docs/sprint-2026-09/technologist-questions.md #14, #15). This is a publication hold, not a statement about physical batches.
